name: 🥦 Beef & Broccoli Wok Night
what: Thin-sliced steak and broccoli in a glossy ginger-garlic sauce over rice.

core.name: Cornstarch
core.out: skip it, the sauce will just be thinner

extras: garlic, ginger, sesame oil, brown sugar, sesame seeds, green onions

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Rice on. Steak into the freezer 15 minutes.
Slice the steak thin across the grain; toss with a little soy and cornstarch. Whisk the sauce: soy, brown sugar, sesame oil, cornstarch, ¾ cup water.
Very hot pan: broccoli with 3 Tbsp water, covered, 3 minutes. Tip out.
Sear the beef in two batches, 1–2 minutes each. Add garlic and ginger, then the sauce.
Toss the broccoli back in. Serve over rice.

key: Two batches in a really hot pan. Crowded beef steams gray.
done: Sauce is glossy and thick, beef has no pink.
plan_b: Steak's not thawed? Make it with chicken or just broccoli and eggs.
